objdata.Description: Prepare to withstand the pursuit of time!
objdata.Name: Temporal Strike-day20

Lines.en: Oh my dear Penny, there's a question that's been rattling around my taco-loving brain...
Lines.zh: 哦我亲爱的潘妮，我一直想问你一个问题

Lines.en: What do you think is the ULTIMATE goal of our travels?
Lines.zh: 你认为我们旅行的终极目标是什么呢

Lines.en: I don't think it can be measured by a physical thing... like, say, a SUPER-DELUXE TACO.
Lines.zh: 我想它不能用一个具体的物体去衡量，例如豪华玉米卷

Lines.en: Take a premium corn tortilla, lovingly bathed in olive oil and toasted to perfection...
Lines.zh: 选用上好的玉米饼，浸润在橄榄油中烘烤

Lines.en: Grilled meat seared golden on both sides, rolled inside with freshly chopped onions and tomato slices...
Lines.zh: 烤肉煎至两面金黄卷入其中，再加入现采现切的洋葱丁和番茄片

Lines.en: Finally, drizzled with the soul sauce – MAYONNAISE...
Lines.zh: 最后淋上灵魂酱料美乃滋....

Lines.en: One bite... and it's a flavor EXPLOSION that echoes through eternity!
Lines.zh: 一口下去回味无穷口牙

Lines.en: Do you recall the topic of discussion prior to your mention of 'super-deluxe tacos,' User Dave?
Lines.zh: 您还记得自己提到'豪华玉米卷'之前的话题吗，用户戴夫

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: Escape the temporal recursion after the final wave
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 从最后一个大波后的循环中逃脱

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: (Tip: Press F10 to check Recurrent Waves status)
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: (提示：按下F10以查看循环波次情况)
